name: OneConstruction Group Limited
summary: OneConstruction Group Ltd. functions as a holding entity primarily dedicated to the sourcing and strategic placement of structural steel elements for various construction initiatives. The company's extensive involvement encompasses preliminary site preparation and foundational tasks, the meticulous creation of project schedules and staff deployment strategies, the execution of on-site construction activities, and stringent oversight to ensure both safety compliance and quality control. This firm, established in 2021, maintains its principal administrative office in Hong Kong.
